segments.title: Opening Chat & Lethal Company Discussion
segments.notes: Case opens with chat interaction, discusses Lethal Company streaming marathon and viewer requests for news stories.

segments.title: Goku Bracken Interview
segments.notes: Case interviews Goku Bracken who repeatedly snaps his neck; ultra instinct music forces emergency feed cut.

segments.title: Chat Persona Segment: Epstein List & George Lucas
segments.notes: Chat joins as on-air personality; discusses Epstein list, George Lucas mention, and Logan Paul CryptoZoo pivot.

segments.title: Logan Paul CryptoZoo Refund Announcement
segments.notes: Case reads Logan Paul's statement launching buyback website and $2.3M personal commitment; Case claims $1.5M personal loss.

segments.title: Hype Train as Tim Paul: Kid-in-Fleur Scheme
segments.notes: Hype Train appears as 'Tim Paul' pitching digital child-influencer hybrids; website returns no results.

segments.title: Conspiracy Time with Clementine: Secret Fifth Ninja Turtle
segments.notes: Clementine unveils Kirby the cancelled fifth Ninja Turtle, Beyonce/Illuminati corn syrup theory, and biblical angel redesigns.

segments.title: Munch Forced Nice: Jan 6 Insurrection vs Protest Debate
segments.notes: Sub goal forces Munch to be contractually nice; Munch argues Jan 6 was protest, Crum argues insurrection; Crum wins poll decisively.

segments.title: Call for an Expert: Steve Copeland Clown Interview
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple researches clown duo; Case interviews impostor Lou Jacobs claiming to be Steve Copeland; real Steve Copeland video shown.

segments.title: Auto-Sexuality Segment with Liliana
segments.notes: Liliana breaks down auto-sexual orientation; Case and Liliana test five signs; personal housing update reveals March move-in delay.

segments.title: DJ Newsic Finale: Trump Colorado Ballot & Kirby the Ninja Turtle
segments.notes: DJ Newsic sings Trump Supreme Court appeal; brings out Kirby the fifth Ninja Turtle who endorses Splinter for president.

segments.title: Raid Outro to Still Do
segments.notes: Case raids Still Do playing Last of Us Part 2; signs off for weekend.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors full broadcast; claims $1.5M CryptoZoo loss; reveals apartment move delayed to March.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Referenced as 'Pappito' by Case; produces show and cuts Goku Bracken feed.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Wins Jan 6 insurrection debate poll decisively; score updated to 20-point lead over Munch.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Contractually forced to be 'nice' at 30 subs; argues Jan 6 was protest; loses debate poll.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: musical correspondent. Appears as 'Tim Paul' pitching kid-in-fluer digital child hybrids; website nonexistent.

characters.name: Clementine
characters.notes: conspiracy correspondent. Reveals secret fifth Ninja Turtle Kirby; connects Beyonce lyrics to corn syrup Illuminati theory.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Researches Steve Copeland clown duo; confused by Show Biz David website.

characters.name: Liliana
characters.notes: desk partner. Breaks down auto-sexuality with clinical sources; reveals housing delay and cat wait until March.

characters.name: DJ Newsic
characters.notes: musical finale host. Euro-dance Trump Colorado ballot coverage; debuts Kirby the Ninja Turtle character.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Mentioned as crawlspace resident; Case references 'cramp between Peter and Pepito'.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Walks through studio discussing Poppy sweepstakes; naps on camera with lights dimmed.

characters.name: Goku Bracken
characters.notes: call-in guest. Repeatedly snaps Case's neck; ultra instinct music triggers emergency eject.

characters.name: Chat
characters.notes: call-in guest. Personified as on-air personality; discusses Epstein list and George Lucas.

characters.name: Steve Copeland / Lou Jacobs
characters.notes: call-in guest. Impostor Lou Jacobs poses as clown Steve Copeland; real Steve Copeland video shown post-interview.

storylines.beat: [01:08:19] Sub goal forces Munch to be contractually 'nice' for debate; Crum wins Jan 6 insurrection poll decisively; score updated to Crum +20.

lore_notes.fact: [01:47:32] Apartment move-in delayed to March; builder originally promised October then November then February.
[01:48:03] Cannot get cat until March due to housing delay; currently in crowded temporary apartment.

[01:08:19] Contractual sub goal (30 subs) forces Munch to be 'nice' for debate segment; Pepito drafted contract.
[01:22:05] Score updated to Crum 20 points ahead of Munch; Munch claims he updated score yesterday.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell delivers a dense two-hour broadcast covering Logan Paul's CryptoZoo refund launch, a contractually mandated 'nice' Munch & Crum debate on January 6th that Crum wins decisively, a clown interview mix-up resolved by Jeff Ripple, Liliana's auto-sexuality breakdown amid personal housing delays, and a DJ Newsic musical finale featuring the debut of Kirby the secret fifth Ninja Turtle endorsing Splinter for president.
